decisions.reason: As a flagship product line close to the firm's core practice management and regulatory workflow knowledge, the firm can readily assimilate feedback and apply its R&D to improve it, making withdrawal unlikely.

The support tool builds directly on existing support resources and integration capabilities, giving the firm the related knowledge to interpret results and enhance the product, so it is likely to be kept.

The analytics dashboard leverages the firm's existing practice data and software engineering knowledge, enabling it to assimilate early results and improve the dashboard through in-house R&D, supporting a keep decision.

The complete bundle is close to the established offer and packages existing products, so the firm already holds the relevant knowledge to maintain and improve it, indicating a very low withdrawal probability.
The job portal is distant from the firm's core software and support knowledge, so the firm lacks the related knowledge to interpret market feedback and improve the portal, making withdrawal likely.
